name: lean-tokens
description: Spend fewer tokens in Claude Code: lean working habits at session start, a setup audit, a handoff command for cheap fresh starts, and optional trimming of noisy test/build output.

session_rules.title: Lean rules at session start
session_rules.description: Adds a short (~200 token) checklist of token-saving habits to Claude's context at the start of each session, after /clear and after compaction.

filter_noisy_output.title: Trim test, build and lint output
filter_noisy_output.description: Rewrites plain test/build/lint/typecheck commands (npm test, pytest, go test, tsc, eslint...) so Claude sees only failures and a summary; the full log is kept in a temp file. Matching commands run without a permission prompt while this is on. Deny and ask rules still apply.
